_meta: G7 fragment (owner: FISSURE7). Creep fissures, canyons and growths (G7_REFERENCE master scope 13.9a, owner amendment 2026-10-26). Sim: sim/systems/fissures7.gd (called from Creep.tick). Every number is PROVISIONAL (untuned balance fixture). Stages: crack (terrain FORD: ground slow), fissure (FOREST: vehicles blocked, infantry slow), canyon (RIDGE: all ground blocked); air unaffected. Codes are content values (stage_codes) so a later dedicated terrain code is a data change. Big growths are Machine buildings (creep sources) that are destructible; the rest are display-only scenery derived from sim state.
